zh.hero_title: 讓 AI、網站、系統與商業策略真正落地
zh.hero_subtitle: 創模工作室專注於 AI 串接、客製化 AI、網站與系統開發、自動化整合、RAG、AI Agent、資安檢查、SEO 與商業研究，協助品牌與企業把想法做成可實際營運、可持續維護、可逐步成長的成果。
zh.about_content:
創模工作室（Create Large Model）致力於把品牌、網站、AI 與營運流程整合成真正可使用的數位資產。

我們不把網站、AI、後台與內容拆成彼此孤立的功能，而是回到實際營運情境，從需求理解、資訊架構、頁面內容、技術落地到後續維護，一起規劃。

我們重視的不只是上線，而是交付之後是否真的能被團隊接手、持續更新，並在正式上線到網域後依然保有後台可調整的彈性。
zh.contact_note: 如果你正在規劃企業官網、品牌網站、AI 導入、RAG、AI Agent、後台系統、流程自動化或 SEO 優化，可以先和我們聊需求、目標、時程與可行方向。正式內容與設定之後也都能在後台持續調整。

en.hero_title: Turn AI, websites, systems, and strategy into real business outcomes
en.hero_subtitle: CLM Studio helps brands and companies turn ideas into maintainable business assets through AI integration, custom AI systems, websites, automation, RAG, AI agents, security reviews, SEO, and research.
en.about_content:
Create Large Model (CLM) focuses on turning brand communication, websites, AI capabilities, and operating workflows into practical digital assets.

We do not treat websites, AI, admin tools, and content as isolated pieces. We plan them in real operating context, from requirements and information architecture to content structure, technical delivery, and long-term maintenance.

Our goal is not just launch. It is to deliver work that teams can continue to manage, update, and expand after the site goes live on a real domain.
en.contact_note: If you are planning a corporate website, brand site, AI integration, RAG, AI agents, admin systems, workflow automation, or SEO improvements, start by telling us your goals, timing, and current constraints. Content and settings can still be adjusted later from the admin side.

Example: Brand Website Redesign | Web Restructure and SEO Case Study

Example: Helped the brand restructure its website and content so service information became clearer and inquiry flow improved.
en.project_detail:

Example: Explain the need first, then what was built, then what improved after launch.

en.media_alt:
Rule: Describe the visible subject and purpose. Do not just write 'image' or 'project photo'.
Example: Homepage visual showing the main brand image and core service entry points.
en.media_title:
Rule: Use a clear media name for backend editing.
Example: Homepage Visual, Admin Flow Demo, Mobile Services Layout.
en.media_caption:
Rule: Explain what this image or video represents inside the case study.
Example: This image shows the first-screen homepage layout and primary call-to-action placement.
en.image_format: Image guidance: alt describes the subject and purpose; title names the media; caption explains why the image matters in the case study.
en.video_format: Video guidance: alt can describe the video content; title names the clip; caption explains the flow or feature being demonstrated.
en.embed_format: Embed guidance: title names the embedded content; caption explains its purpose; if alt is available, describe the displayed topic.
